children: NOV reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.23 billion, up 2% year over year, and net income attributable to the company of $90 million. Diluted earnings were $0.25 per share, while Adjusted EBITDA was $281 million. The company expects fourth-quarter revenue to be roughly flat year over year.
Revenue was $2.226 billion, up 2% year over year and 4% sequentially.
Gross profit was $439 million, equal to 19.7% of revenue.
Operating profit was $142 million, or 6.4% of revenue.
Net income attributable to NOV was $90 million; diluted earnings per share were $0.25.
Adjusted EBITDA was $281 million, or 12.6% of revenue, compared with $258 million a year earlier. The quarter included an approximately $5 million benefit from tariff refunds.

Energy Equipment activity was affected by the completion of certain offshore production projects; increased demand for other products and services did not fully offset the change. The segment’s capital equipment backlog was $3.98 billion at quarter-end.

Energy Products and Services increased manufacturing throughput against a growing backlog of drill pipe and composite equipment, supported by continued cost-structure and operational-efficiency improvements.
NOV secured orders spanning offshore mooring systems, drillship upgrades, composite spoolable linepipe, well-service rig electrification, and offshore wind installation vessel designs and equipment.

The company expects Middle East activity to moderate in the fourth quarter as some customers adjust drilling programs, with geopolitical conditions continuing to pose potential operational disruption.

title: NOV Reports Q3 Revenue of $2.23 Billion and Net Income of $90 Million
